idea.title: What agents keep telling us
idea.angle: The pain points we hear in conversations: slow replies, missed bookings, wasted ad spend
idea.hook: What agents in Ghana and Nigeria keep telling us

slides.heading: **Field notes:** what agents tell us
slides.body: Notes from our early conversations with agents in Ghana and Nigeria. No results to show yet. Just what we're hearing.

slides.heading: **Leads** aren't the problem
slides.body: Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, website enquiries: the leads are there. The complaint is always about what happens after the message lands.

slides.heading: A buyer asked for details. I got busy. By the time I replied, they'd gone quiet.
Slow replies cost more than **bad listings**
slides.body: A buyer asking about a flat in East Legon is often asking other agents too. The first helpful reply has the advantage.

slides.heading: **Viewings** die in the follow-up gap
slides.body: The buyer says "let me check my schedule." Nobody checks back. The viewing never gets booked, and nobody notices it was lost.

slides.heading: Ads don't fail. **Replies** do.
slides.body: You pay in cedis or naira to boost a listing. On a busy day the leads sit unanswered. The ad brought the lead. The process lost it.

slides.heading: **Building** for the gap, not the lead
slides.body: We're early: a two-person team, no client results yet. We're designing around these three leaks first: reply speed, booking follow-up and ad leads.

slides.heading: **Follow along** as we build this

caption:
What agents keep telling us, in our early conversations.

Nobody says they need more leads.
They say the buyer went quiet before they could reply.
They say the viewing never got booked.
They say they paid for ads and the leads sat unanswered.

We're a two-person team, early, no client results to show yet. So we're sharing what we hear and what we're building around it.

Which of these three hits your business hardest right now? Tell me in the comments.
